_doc: Registry of the cloud-me-pvt hub. A SUBSET of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json, narrowed to the private cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pvt). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model. Private members are linked only: the index exposes their name, never their content.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-vault
repos.doc: Secrets (sops/age). Every credential the fleet uses.

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-cgc
repos.doc: The PRIVATE half of the cgc pipeline (pvt surface: the private repos -> cloud-cgc-pvt-mcp). A thin orchestrator rendered from cloudy-u-containers_cgc at a pinned sha, so private-repo runs and logs stay private. Was cloud-u-containers_cgc-pvt; renamed 2026-10-10 into the private cloud-me family (split-outs are named <parent>_<name>; every cloud-u-* repo is public).

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-configs
repos.doc: Private configs (cloud-me family). Added 2026-10-15: it existed but was missing here, so clone.sh and --sync skipped it. (/home/user/cloud-vault is just a second clone of cloud-me-pvt-vault, not a separate repo.)

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-data
repos.doc: Generated fleet config consumed by cloud's services.

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-my-ai
repos.doc: Claude Code's durable state and the source it runs from. ~/.claude symlinks in, not out: a_sessions/<instance>/ holds transcripts, file-history, shell-snapshots and history.jsonl; b_projects/ holds MEMORY.md and memory-entries; a_commits/ snapshots every commit object of every repo here.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field - every member links at the root of this index, same as CG and Fin-CM.
